nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Hourly, per the WF-101 row in docs/workflows.md.

parameters.query:
-- Everything WF-101 judges, in one round trip. Read models first
-- (docs/workflows.md says workflows query the views, not hand-rolled joins),
-- then the three facts the views do not cover: stuck runs, queue depth, and
-- notifications that could not be delivered.
--
-- No thresholds are applied here. This node reports; Evaluate Health decides.
-- Keeping the judgement in one place is what makes it testable.
WITH params AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p),
stuck AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int AS stuck_runs,
           COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'agent',      r.agent_name,
               'run_id',     r.id,
               'company_id', r.company_id,
               'started_at', r.started_at,
               'minutes',    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - r.started_at)) / 60)::int
           ) ORDER BY r.started_at), '[]'::json) AS stuck_detail
    FROM agent_runs r, params
    WHERE r.status = 'running'
      AND r.started_at < now() - make_interval(mins => (params.p ->> 'stuck_minutes')::int)
),
health AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'agent',           agent_name,
               'runs_24h',        runs_24h,
               'succeeded',       succeeded,
               'failed',          failed,
               'in_flight',       in_flight,
               'avg_duration_ms', avg_duration_ms,
               'last_run_at',     last_run_at
           ) ORDER BY agent_name), '[]'::json) AS agents
    FROM v_agent_health
),
queues AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE status = 'new')::int         AS research_pending,
        (SELECT min(created_at) FROM companies WHERE status = 'new')       AS research_oldest,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE status = 'researched')::int  AS scoring_pending,
        (SELECT min(updated_at) FROM companies WHERE status = 'researched') AS scoring_oldest,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM leads
          WHERE status = 'new'
            AND COALESCE(score, 0) >= (SELECT (p ->> 'min_score')::int FROM params))::int AS outreach_pending,
        (SELECT min(created_at) FROM leads WHERE status = 'new')           AS outreach_oldest,
        -- A company parked at 'researching' long after any run could still be
        -- alive is WF-02 having died without WF-99 closing it.
        (SELECT count(*) FROM companies
          WHERE status = 'researching'
            AND updated_at < now() - make_interval(mins => (SELECT (p ->> 'orphan_minutes')::int FROM params)))::int AS orphaned_researching
),
outbox AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int AS undelivered,
           count(*) FILTER (
               WHERE status = 'failed'
                 AND attempts >= (SELECT (p ->> 'max_attempts')::int FROM params)
           )::int AS undeliverable
    FROM notifications, params
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed')
)
SELECT health.agents,
       stuck.stuck_runs,
       stuck.stuck_detail,
       queues.research_pending,
       queues.research_oldest,
       queues.scoring_pending,
       queues.scoring_oldest,
       queues.outreach_pending,
       queues.outreach_oldest,
       queues.orphaned_researching,
       outbox.undelivered,
       outbox.undeliverable,
       now() AS checked_at
FROM health, stuck, queues, outbox;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ stuck_minutes: Number($env.HEALTH_STUCK_RUN_MINUTES || 15), orphan_minutes: Number($env.HEALTH_ORPHAN_RESEARCH_MINUTES || 120), min_score: Number($env.OUTREACH_MIN_SCORE || 60), max_attempts: Number($env.NOTIFY_MAX_ATTEMPTS || 5) } ) }}

nodes.name: Any Alerts?
nodes.notes: True branch carries one item per alert.

parameters.query:
-- One alert per item. queue_notification owns the deduplication rule
-- (0011_notifications.sql): a health problem that is still open is counted,
-- not re-sent, which is what stops an hourly schedule from sending 24 copies
-- of the same failure a day.
SELECT q.notification_id,
       q.status,
       q.occurrences,
       q.deduplicated,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'dedup_key' AS dedup_key
FROM queue_notification(
         'agent_health',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'dedup_key',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'title',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'body',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'priority',
         $1::jsonb -> 'payload',
         NULL,
         NULL,
         make_interval(mins => ($1::jsonb ->> 'cooloff_minutes')::int)
     ) q;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ dedup_key: $json.dedup_key, title: $json.title, body: $json.body, priority: $json.priority, payload: $json.payload, cooloff_minutes: Number($env.HEALTH_ALERT_COOLOFF_MINUTES || 360) } ) }}
